sections.heading: Bank Exam Document Specifications.
body: Portals run by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) and State Bank of India (SBI) require PDF uploads for resumes, ID proofs, age relaxation certificates, and work experience letters.

These documents must be scanned and uploaded as PDF files, with a strict size cap of 500 KB. Text legibility is critical, as banking applications undergo rigorous automated and manual validation processes.

faq.q: What is the PDF size limit for SBI and IBPS applications?
faq.a: For bank exam applications, the maximum size limit for supporting document PDFs (such as resume, educational records, age proof) is 500 KB.
